title: Caps and LCD Codes with Large Dimensions
summary: We establish a connection between linear complementary dual (LCD) codes and caps in projective space. Using this framework and the structure theory of maximal binary caps, we derive nonexistence theorems for binary LCD codes with minimum distance at least $4$, providing computation-free proofs that were previously obtained only through exhaustive search. As an application, we completely determine the optimal minimum distances for codimensions $7$ and $8$ for the first time.
